scenes.name: TWELVE GATES
lines: Twelve gates sit on a chain of eleven sites. How long does this circuit take?
一条 11 个格点的链上排着 12 道门。这段电路要走多久？
Count the gates, and you get twelve. Count the ticks of the clock, and you get four.
数门，是 12；数时钟走了几拍，只有 4。
So why do we assume that more gates always means more time?
那我们凭什么以为，门越多，时间就越长？

scenes.name: WHO TOUCHES WHOM
lines: Each gate grips two neighbouring sites. The two end gates grip just one.
每道门抓住相邻的两个格点；两头的边界门只抓一个。
Gates that share a site can't fire on the same tick: two hands, one doorknob.
共用一个格点的两道门不能在同一拍里动作：两只手抓不了同一个门把手。
Gates that share nothing can fire together. That set is a layer.
互不相碰的门可以一起动作，这样一组门就是一层。
The depth is the fewest layers that keep every shared site in order.
深度，就是让每个共用格点都按先后走完所需的最少层数。

scenes.name: THREE RELAY TEAMS
lines: Here the order runs one way along the chain, except at turning points.
在这族电路里，先后次序沿着链朝一个方向走，只在折返点掉头。
Put turning points at sites four and eight, and the chain falls into three pieces of four.
把折返点放在格点 4 和 8，链就断成三段，每段 4 道门。
Inside a piece, each gate waits for its neighbour, like a relay handing on a baton.
同一段里，每道门都要等邻居做完，就像接力赛一棒传一棒。
But the three teams run side by side. Four legs each, so four ticks in all.
可三支队伍是并排跑的：每队 4 棒，总共只要 4 拍。
With eight sites: three teams of three, and three ticks.
换成 8 个格点：三队、每队 3 道门，走 3 拍。

scenes.name: THE FLOOR
lines: Lean checks the general rule. Take N sites and kappa turning points, kappa at least one, N at least twice kappa.
Lean 内核检验了一般规律：N 个格点、κ 个折返点，κ 至少为 1，N 至少是 κ 的两倍。
Then the least depth over all placements is N over kappa plus one, rounded down, plus one.
那么对折返点的一切摆法取最小，深度恰好是 N 除以 κ+1 向下取整再加 1。
Why not less? The cuts leave kappa plus one pieces, and the biggest piece alone needs one tick per gate.
为什么不能更少？κ 个折返点把链切成 κ+1 段，最长的那段有几道门，单独就要几拍。
A circuit's time is not the number of steps. It is the longest line that has to wait.
电路的时间不是步数，而是那条必须排队等候的最长队伍。

scenes.name: TWO GUESSES FAIL
lines: A recent paper guessed a different rule: roughly half the chain, minus kappa.
一篇新近的论文猜了另一条规律：大约链长的一半，减去 κ。
With one turning point, the guesses match the true rule.
只有一个折返点时，两条猜想公式与真实规律完全吻合。
With two, they break. At eight sites the guess says four ticks, the circuit runs in three. At eleven, five against four.
两个折返点就破了：8 个格点，公式说 4 拍，实际 3 拍；11 个格点，5 拍对 4 拍。
Lean checks that both formulas fail. Their slope is a half; with two turning points, the true slope is a third.
Lean 内核检验：两条都不成立。猜想斜率 1/2，κ = 2 时真值斜率只有 1/3。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: Now the tempting leap: physicists conjecture that complexity grows like the volume inside a black hole.
现在是那一步诱人的跳跃：物理学家猜想，复杂度像黑洞内部的体积一样增长。
That is complexity equals volume, and it is open. So is ER equals EPR: entanglement as a wormhole.
这就是复杂度等于体积，它是开放问题；ER=EPR，把纠缠读成虫洞，也是开放问题。
Our count lives in one family of circuits. It is not the fewest gates for any target, nor physical time.
我们数的只是一族电路的层数：不是任意目标的最少门数，也不是物理时间。
Refuting two depth formulas says nothing about black holes. Ticks counted are not volume measured.
推翻两条深度公式，对黑洞什么也没说。数出来的拍数，不是量出来的体积。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter twenty.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第二十章
